title: Browse and launch the tactical shooter from the lobby
description: Verifies that a player can find the tactical shooter in the arcade lobby, launch it, and enter agent selection successfully.

steps.description: Filter games by the tactical category
Verify the tactical shooter game card is visible
Verify the agent selection screen is displayed

title: Select an agent and enter a match
description: Verifies that a player can choose an agent from the selection grid and enter an active Valorant 2D match.

steps.description: Select an agent from the selection grid
Verify the match view is displayed

title: Move, aim, and use abilities in a live round
description: Verifies that a player can control the agent with movement, aim and firing, and the assigned ability keys during a match.

steps.description: Select an agent from the selection grid
Move the agent with the movement keys
Aim and fire with the mouse
Verify the agent position or combat state changes in the match

title: Buy equipment during the buy phase
description: Verifies that a player can open the shop during the buy phase and purchase weapons or shields successfully.

steps.description: Select an agent from the selection grid
Verify the purchased item is reflected in the shop or loadout state

title: Defuse the Spike and see the round result update
description: Verifies that a player can defend successfully by defusing the Spike in the correct zone and that the round outcome updates afterward.

steps.description: Select an agent from the selection grid
Reach a valid Spike defuse zone
Verify the round outcome is displayed

title: Plant the Spike at the correct objective zone
description: Verifies that a player can reach a valid site and plant the Spike only when positioned in the designated objective zone.

steps.description: Select an agent from the selection grid
Reach a valid Spike plant zone
Verify the Spike plant state is shown

title: Search for a game and launch it from results
description: Verifies that a player can search the arcade lobby for a game, see matching results, and launch the selected title.

steps.description: Enter a search term for the tactical shooter
Verify matching game results are displayed
Launch the tactical shooter from the search results
Verify the agent selection screen is displayed

title: Return to the lobby after exiting a launched game
description: Verifies that leaving a launched arcade game brings the player back to the lobby without losing access to navigation.

steps.description: Launch any arcade game from the lobby
Verify the game view is displayed
Verify the arcade lobby is displayed

title: Spectate teammates after elimination until the round ends
description: Verifies that an eliminated player can cycle through teammates in spectator mode and remain in spectate view until the round finishes.

steps.description: Select an agent from the selection grid
Cycle to the next teammate while spectating
Cycle to the previous teammate while spectating
Verify spectator mode remains active until the round ends

title: Launch a different arcade title from the hub and return
description: Verifies that a player can open another arcade title from the hub, interact briefly, and return to the lobby afterward.

steps.description: Launch a non-shooter arcade title from the hub
Verify the selected game view is displayed
Verify the arcade lobby is displayed
